notes: Timeline inspector colour + navigation. (1) Custom colour picker now renders reliably: the rainbow 'custom' swatch is a span (the old <label> + nested <input type=color> didn't show on Safari) and it opens the OS colour picker via a transient input. (2) Second colour row: when the style is Glow, a 'Glow' row appears below 'Colour' for the glow (outline) colour — the two rows are independent (Colour → glow-text, Glow → glow colour). (3) 'All controls' now has a Back button to return to the clean inspector. Note: Box-style background is still a fixed semi-transparent black in the renderer, so a 'Box colour' control needs a dedicated render field — not included here.
